subject: Accounting
pacing_note: The IEB publishes no ATP equivalent; term placement and week spans are the DBE ATP pacing carried over as a default. IEB schools set their own pacing — treat weeks as advisory.
assessment_note: DBE SBA programmes, control-test scopes and exam structures are deliberately stripped: IEB assessment is specified by the IEB Subject Assessment Guidelines (see ../exam_guidelines/), which have not been ingested yet. Do not fall back to the CAPS exam_structure for IEB papers.
scope_deltas: SAG-stated content-scope differences vs the CAPS/DBE prescription are recorded in scope_deltas.json in this folder (hand-maintained, SAG-transcribed only; an empty ledger means 'not yet transcribed', never 'no differences').

topics.name: COMPANIES: UNIQUE TRANSACTIONS (Close corporations: Not assessed)
subtopics: Company concepts: public vs private companies, Companies Act 71 of 2008, registration/MOI, income tax and provisional tax, dividends, shares, earnings, shareholders, limited liability, separation of ownership and control, directors, auditors, retained income, authorised vs issued share capital, JSE
IFRS and GAAP; specific GAAP principles
Company accounting cycle: journals, ledger accounts, trial balance
Transactions: share issues at issue price (no par value), share buy-backs, loans with capitalised interest, income tax, dividends, directors' fees, audit fees
topics.prior_knowledge: Companies Act 71 of 2008 basics; shares and JSE trading procedures; MOI

topics.name: COMPANIES: FINAL ACCOUNTS, FINANCIAL STATEMENTS Statement of comprehensive income, statement of financial position, cash flow statement and audit report
subtopics: Year-end adjustments including provision for bad debts, income tax adjustments, declaration and payment of dividends
Final accounts: trading, profit and loss, appropriation; reversal of accruals/deferrals/prepayments
Financial statements and notes: income statement, balance sheet, cash flow statement
Effect of all company transactions on the accounting equation
Fixed-asset reporting and control, ethics, internal audit, corporate governance, roles of shareholders and directors, share-price manipulation
topics.prior_knowledge: Gr 10-11 year-end adjustments, final accounts and financial statements; purpose of the cash flow statement; King Code III basics; SAICA/SAIPA codes of conduct

topics.name: COMPANIES: ANALYSIS AND INTERPRETATION
subtopics: Revise Gr 11 indicators: profitability, liquidity (incl. stock turnover/holding, debtors' collection, creditors' payment periods), solvency, debt-equity

Introduce: return on shareholders' equity (ROSHE), return on total capital employed (ROTCE), net asset value per share (NAV), dividends per share (DPS), earnings per share (EPS), dividend pay-out rate
Analysis of published financial statements and annual reports: directors' report, independent auditor's report, abridged statements, governance information
topics.prior_knowledge: Gr 10-11 financial indicators; JSE trading and share-price determination vs NAV

topics.name: INVENTORY VALUATION
subtopics: Validation, valuation and calculation under perpetual and periodic systems: specific identification, FIFO, weighted average
GAAP principles, ethics, internal audit and control for inventories
topics.prior_knowledge: Gr 11 inventory management; related financial indicators; Gr 10-11 GAAP and ethics

topics.name: FIXED ASSETS, INTERNAL CONTROL
subtopics: Interpretation and reporting on movement of assets: age, replacement rate, lifespan
Internal audit processes: gathering audit evidence, sampling techniques, internal audit reports, accountable management of resources
Difference between the roles of internal and external auditors
topics.prior_knowledge: Gr 11 fixed assets; background on audit processes

topics.name: COST ACCOUNTING
subtopics: Concepts unique to a manufacturing business
Production cost statement with notes; abridged income statement with administration and selling/distribution notes
Calculations: gross profit on finished goods sold, variable and fixed costs, unit cost, break-even point, total production cost
Manufacturing ethics: product quality and age, raw materials, local products, price fixing, theft, fraud
Internal audit and control in manufacturing
topics.prior_knowledge: Gr 10-11 manufacturing content, accounts and calculations

topics.name: RECONCILIATIONS
subtopics: Analyse and interpret bank, debtors' and creditors' reconciliations
Reconcile creditors' statements with creditors-ledger accounts; debtors/creditors lists with control accounts
Analyse and interpret debtors' age analysis
Analyse and interpret bank statements and bank reconciliation statements
Ethics, internal audit and control: payment periods, interest, credit rating, fraud
topics.prior_knowledge: Gr 10-11 reconciliations; ethics and internal control over cash, debtors and creditors

topics.name: VAT
subtopics: VAT calculations (Gr 11 revision)
Calculate the amount payable to or receivable from SARS
VAT control ledger account as an additional calculation method
Ethics, internal audit and control
topics.prior_knowledge: Gr 10-11 VAT content, ethics and internal control concepts

topics.name: Budgeting
subtopics: Projected income statement with projected revenue and expenditure (Gr 11 content); differences vs cash budgets
Analysis, interpretation and comparison of projected income statements for sole traders or companies
Analysis, interpretation and comparison of cash budgets (receipts, payments, debtors' collection, creditors' payments, cash balances)
Budgeted vs actual figures; ethics, internal audit and control
topics.prior_knowledge: Gr 10 budgets and projections; budgeted vs actual figures as planning/forecasting tools

FINAL NCS EXAM (TWO PAPERS on different days)
